too-many-resets: Codsiyo dib-u-dejin furo sir ah oo aad u badan. Fadlan sug dhowr daqiiqo oo isku day mar kale.
too-many-email-links: Email-o la codsaday oo aad u badan. Fadlan sug dhowr daqiiqo oo isku day mar kale.
too-many-attempts: Isku day aad u badan. Fadlan sug dhowr daqiiqo oo isku day mar kale.
too-many-codes: Koodhad la isku dayay oo aad u badan. Fadlan sug dhowr daqiiqo oo isku day mar kale.
too-many-tokens: Access token-yo aan shaqaynayn oo aad u badan ayaa laga isku dayay cinwaankan. Fadlan sug dhowr daqiiqo oo isku day mar kale.
too-many-shared-views: Habab la wadaagay oo aad u badan ayaa laga furay cinwaankan. Fadlan sug dhowr daqiiqo oo isku day mar kale.
too-many-deletes: Access token-kani wuxuu Qashinka u raray diiwaanno aad u badan saacaddii la soo dhaafay. Fadlan mar dambe isku day.
too-many-changes: Isbeddello aad u badan ayaa akoonkan lagu sameeyay access token-yo. Fadlan muddo sug oo isku day mar kale; isbeddellada website-ka weli way shaqeeyaan.
too-many-mcp: Codsiyo aad u badan oo loo diray qalabka Glazecalc ee kaaliyeyaasha AI. Fadlan sug dhowr daqiiqo oo isku day mar kale.
too-many-oauth: Codsiyo xidhid app oo aad u badan oo ka yimid cinwaankan. Fadlan sug dhowr daqiiqo oo isku day mar kale.
too-many-registrations: App-yo aad u badan ayaa is diiwaangeliyay. Fadlan mar dambe isku day.
too-many-imports: Soo gelinno aad u badan ayaa akoonkan lagu sameeyay saacaddii la soo dhaafay. Fadlan isku day mar dambe.
